backup.title: Automatic backups
backup.description: Plain JSON snapshots of all people/categories/events, saved to config/homeroster_backups/ - independent of this integration's own storage, so they survive an accidental removal or a bad update. To create, list or restore a backup on demand (including one from another instance - just place its file in that folder first), use the homeroster.create_backup / list_backups / restore_backup actions (Developer tools -> Actions).

data.backup_retention_count: Keep the last N backups (0 = keep all forever)
